prompts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset: genuinely transparent panoramic footer illustration. Input image is exact subject/composition reference, NOT a texture or color reference. Make a RADICAL original reinterpretation of this same family garden as a sophisticated ARCHITECT'S WORKING BLUEPRINT / ENGINEERING SURVEY. The scene must read immediately as a plan, from its marks and construction, without being a blue painting.
Keep the composition 2.74:1 wide with house left, tree left-middle, hanging chair below tree, father holding baby and mother seen from behind center-right, exactly two cats around them, coastal bay and foreground sunflowers. Same overall positions and recognizable subjects.
MEDIUM: pure ivory and electric cyan CAD linework, generous negative space, exact varying line weights, crisp geometric strokes. No painterly grain, no photographic shading, no lush filled foliage. No filled blue rectangle: all empty background and sky MUST be transparent alpha; viewer's #003366 page provides the blue.
House is an architectural cutaway elevation: reveal roof trusses, window mullions, wall thickness, floor slab sections, sparse 45-degree hatching inside sliced masonry. Add fine dimension chains and extension lines around facade, roof pitch angles, small section symbols. Not an additional building.
Tree is a wonderful constructed botanical schematic: wireframe branches, individual branching vectors, schematic circular/hexagonal foliage clusters, an inset circular branch cross-section connected by thin leader. Preserve the tree silhouette while reducing clutter.
Hanging chair becomes a precise mechanical detail with exploded seat/ring contours and suspension-angle construction arc, remaining in its original place.
Family figures become restrained architect's scale silhouettes outlined in ivory with subtle construction joints, baby's held pose obvious. Exactly two striped cats are elegantly drafted with construction ellipses and one small movement-radius arc.
Foreground garden becomes botanical technical drawings: sunflower heads with radial Fibonacci construction, sectioned stems and root cutaway at the bottom; tiny circles and crosses register positions. The coast is a land-survey plan, contour lines, coastal section lines and numbered bench marks, sea as widely-spaced thin cyan survey lines.
Clouds are sparse meteorological contour/isobar outlines with dashed construction guides, never shaded fluffy painted masses. Leave abundant empty transparent sky.
Add a sparse base perspective grid integrated into the terrain and a few miniature authentic numbers/scale ticks only, no prose/caption/title/logo. Small redline marks in warm coral (under 2% of pixels) create art-director personality. The result is a beautifully composed blueprint draft, not a busy collage. Clean transparent output, no paper, no checkerboard, no frame. Fill lower edge with drafted garden lines.

Use case: style-transfer. Input image: composition and subject reference for an original terminal-art footer, not painted surfaces. Re-create the same scene as ACTUAL high-craft ASCII / ANSI character-art on a consistent monospaced grid. Wide panorama 2.74:1, true transparent empty sky and between leaves, no black backdrop rectangle. Preserve house at left, large tree left-center, empty hanging chair, father holding baby and mother facing sea center-right, exactly two cats, Mediterranean bay, foreground sunflowers.
Make the medium unmistakable: every visible form BUILT FROM legible tiny glyphs such as / \ | _ + = : . , ; # % @ [ ] and box-drawing line fragments, aligned rows and columns, visible stepped character cells. Use terminal #33ff00 phosphor characters and deep green character shading; selected windows/flowers amber #ffb000. Nothing is a painted photograph or smooth engraved stroke. House outline uses box-drawing structure, brick courses are text-cell hatch patterns, branches form branching slash and pipe glyphs, foliage compact @%# clusters. The wicker chair uses nested bracket/ring glyph outlines. The family and baby are recognizable character-art silhouettes with clear separate poses, compact cats with stepped stripe patterns. Sea made of broken equals and tilde bands. Sunflowers constructed as radial glyph rosettes. Sparse glyph clouds, no dense pale solid cloud blocks. Detailed quiet sophisticated hacker terminal artwork with a few amber highlighted architectural strokes. The upper scene breaks into sparse individual characters at its edges to integrate with page; all gaps really alpha transparent. No readable phrases, UI boxes, Matrix code rain, added objects, weapons or logos.

Use case: style-transfer. Make an ultra-characterful 1990s 16-bit point-and-click adventure scene for a GeoCities/Windows95 personal-site footer. Input is exact subject/placement reference. Wide 2.74:1 same garden: cream house left with blue shutters, large tree left-center, hanging chair, father holding baby and mother facing sea center-right, exactly two cats foreground, sea and curved coast, sunflowers at both bottom corners.
REDRAW from scratch as true chunky sprite art: visibly square 3-5 pixel blocks at final 2048-wide scale, hard stepped silhouettes, tight 32-color palette, hand-placed checkerboard dithering and dark navy outlines. Rich playful EGA-like color harmonies: teal shadows, lemon sunflowers, magenta/coral flowers, cyan and cobalt sea, pale yellow house. Every texture uses intentional pixel clusters, no brushwork or smooth gradients.
The family and striped cats look like lovingly crafted adventure-game sprites; retain original same family count and baby held securely. House architecture uses crisp outlined tile geometry; tree has beautiful layered pixel leaf masses, hanging wicker chair an intricate pixel ring. Sea sparkling pixel wave bands; distant villas miniature block sprites. Bold color, charming analog-computer nostalgia, readable pixel detail, ingenious handcrafted clusters. Cloud forms are lightly dithered stepped outlines with clear true transparent open sky; all sky gaps and leaf holes alpha. Slight magical 90s game illustration charm without adding fantasy objects. No interface, borders, text, extra characters or animals, no false checkerboard background.

Use case: style-transfer. Reimagine the reference as a distinctive stylized Source-engine Mediterranean map diorama for a Counter-Strike-like tactical FPS website theme. Wide 2.74:1 exact landmark composition: house left, big tree left-center, hanging chair under it, family with safely-held baby center-right, exactly two cats foreground, coastal bay, garden sunflowers. Maintain domestic scene and character count.
Art direction: unmistakably REALTIME 3D LEVEL ART, architectural game environment with purposeful low-poly geometry and hand-painted diffuse textures, crisp modeled edges, vertex-lit foliage clumps, visible faceted tree branches, baked ambient-occlusion shadows, boxy modeled shutters/roof tiles, geometric wicker chair. Cohesive polished 2000s Source-game loading-map aesthetic, a tiny bit stylized, beautifully art directed and tactile. NOT photoreal family photography, oil painting, sepia tint, monochrome filtering or generic 3D stock render.
Cool overcast-blue stone light with subtle warm sun streaks, navy shadows, muted sage foliage, modeled golden sunflower clusters, azure sea with stylized planar wave reflections. House looks like a recognizable carefully made seaside game-map landmark. Family wears ordinary summer clothes in source pose, rendered as warm simplified believable 3D characters; no combat gear. Cats have crisp striped game textures and modeled silhouettes. True transparent open sky with a few delicate modeled cloud masses, transparent leaf gaps. The website's pale blue-grey #c9d2d9 background provides the sky. No weapons, soldiers, combat, UI, crosshairs, text, labels or extra animals. Preserve full-width lower garden edge and a relaxed immersive quiet-vista mood.
